about: Queue for the Mobile Ankles (Ankles & Feet) mannequin clips, generated in the Gemini web app the same way as the Open Hips clips (Create video, Portrait, text only, one new chat per clip). DRAFT: the program in content/programs/ankles.ts and these pose descriptions were written by Claude from general coaching knowledge; Felipe has not checked them yet.
template: A smooth beige 3D anatomy mannequin, male, faceless with no eyes and no mouth, visible ball joints at shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees and ankles, athletic build, wearing only black shorts, white crew socks and white sneakers. Dark gym, black rubber floor, neon green rim light from the right, nobody else in the room. {view}, static camera that never moves, entire body in frame, no tripod or camera equipment anywhere in the room. He starts already in this position: {start} He does only one movement: {motion} Exactly 3 slow repetitions, then he holds still in the starting position. He never changes position and never does any other movement. Working muscles: {glow}. They light up as glowing neon green anatomical muscle fibers drawn as a graphic overlay on top of the body and on top of the black shorts, so wherever a working muscle is under the shorts its glow shows on the shorts too, with visible fiber strands in the real shape of each muscle, brightest while the muscle works and dimmer when it rests. No red or skinless muscle anywhere: outside the green glow the body stays smooth plain beige. No cuts, no text. Portrait 9:16.
run_rules: Same run rules as assets/glossary/hips-queue.json (read its run_rules). Clips for this program go to public/programs/ankles/clips/<exercise-slug>.mp4 and are listed in content/programs/program-clips.ts under "ankles".

clips.name: Ankle Circles
clips.start: sitting on the floor, legs straight in front, hands on the floor behind the hips, right leg lifted a little so the right heel is just off the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the right leg still in the air, he draws big slow circles with the right foot, only the ankle moving, the toes passing up, out, down and in. He never moves the knee, never changes direction and never switches feet.
clips.glow: only the right shin and the right calf, on the back of the right lower leg, from behind the right knee down to the right heel. No glow on the thighs, the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Calf Raises
clips.start: standing tall, feet hip width apart, fingertips lightly touching a wall in front of him for balance.
clips.motion: he rises up onto the balls of both feet as high as he can, pauses at the top, then lowers the heels slowly to the floor. He never bends the knees and never bounces.
clips.glow: only both calves, on the back of the lower legs, from behind the knees down to the heels. No glow on the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Wall Calf Stretch
clips.start: standing facing a wall, both hands on the wall at shoulder height, left foot forward with the left knee bent, right leg straight back with the right heel flat on the floor.
clips.motion: keeping the right heel pressed down and the right leg straight, he leans his hips toward the wall, pauses, then eases back. He never lifts the back heel and never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right calf, on the back of the right lower leg, from behind the right knee down to the right heel. No glow on the thighs, the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Kneeling Shin Stretch
clips.start: kneeling and sitting back on the heels, the tops of both feet flat on the floor with the toes pointing straight back, hands on the floor beside the knees.
clips.motion: keeping the tops of the feet on the floor, he leans back on his hands and lifts both knees a little off the floor, pauses, then lowers the knees back down. He never stands up.
clips.glow: only the front of both shins (the tibialis), the muscle right beside the shin bone from just below the knee down to the ankle. No glow on the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Tibialis Raises
clips.start: standing with his back and glutes leaning against a wall, feet together about one foot length out from the wall, legs straight, arms by his sides.
clips.motion: keeping the heels on the floor and the legs straight, he lifts the toes and the front of both feet as high as he can, pauses, then lowers them back down. The heels never lift.
clips.glow: only the front of both shins (the tibialis), the muscle right beside the shin bone from just below the knee down to the ankle. No glow on the calves, the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Knee to Wall Rocks
clips.start: half kneeling facing a wall, right foot flat on the floor about a hand length from the wall, left knee on the floor behind, both hands on the wall.
clips.motion: keeping the right heel flat on the floor, he drives the right knee forward over the toes until it touches the wall, pauses, then rocks back. The heel never lifts and he never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right calf, on the back of the right lower leg, from behind the right knee down to the right heel, and the front of the right ankle. No glow on the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Single Leg Calf Raise
clips.start: standing on the right foot, left foot hooked behind the right ankle, fingertips of the right hand lightly touching a wall for balance.
clips.motion: he rises up onto the ball of the right foot as high as he can, pauses, then lowers the right heel slowly. He never switches feet and the left foot never touches the floor.
clips.glow: only the right calf, on the back of the right lower leg, from behind the right knee down to the right heel. No glow on the thighs, the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Down Dog Calf Stretch
clips.start: in downward dog: hands and feet on the floor, hips high, arms and back straight, right leg straight, left knee bent with the left heel lifted.
clips.motion: keeping the hands planted and the right leg straight, he presses the right heel down toward the floor, pauses, then lets it lift a little. He never walks or pedals the feet and never switches legs.
clips.glow: only the right calf, on the back of the right lower leg, from behind the right knee down to the right heel. No glow on the arms, the back or the left leg. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Bent Knee Calf Raise
clips.start: standing with the feet hip width apart and both knees bent forward, torso upright, fingertips lightly touching a wall in front of him.
clips.motion: keeping the knees bent the same amount, he rises onto the balls of both feet, pauses, then lowers the heels slowly. The knees never straighten.
clips.glow: only the lower calves, the flat muscles on the back of both lower legs from mid-calf down to the heels. No glow on the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Deep Squat Ankle Rocks
clips.start: in a deep squat with both heels flat on the floor, feet shoulder width apart, hips low near the heels, forearms resting on the knees.
clips.motion: keeping both heels glued to the floor, he shifts his knees forward past his toes, pauses, then rocks back. He never stands up and the heels never lift.
clips.glow: only both calves, on the back of the lower legs, from behind the knees down to the heels, and the front of both ankles. No glow on the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Eccentric Calf Lowers
clips.start: standing on the edge of a low box on the ball of the right foot, right heel lifted high above the edge, left foot lifted behind him, fingertips touching a wall for balance.
clips.motion: he lowers the right heel very slowly until it drops below the edge of the box, pauses, then rises back up onto the ball of the right foot. The left foot never touches down and he never switches feet.
clips.glow: only the right calf, on the back of the right lower leg, from behind the right knee down to the right heel. No glow on the thighs, the left leg or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red

clips.name: Deep Squat Calf Raises
clips.start: in a deep squat with both heels flat on the floor, feet shoulder width apart, hips low near the heels, hands clasped in front of the chest.
clips.motion: staying in the deep squat with the hips low, he lifts both heels as high as he can onto the balls of the feet, pauses, then lowers the heels back to the floor. He never stands up.
clips.glow: only both calves, on the back of the lower legs, from behind the knees down to the heels. No glow on the thighs or the arms. When they rest the skin is plain smooth beige, never red
